NONE: › one of two or more people who write a book, article, report, etc. together
（書、文章或報告等的）合著者
› to write a book, article, report, etc. together with another person or other people
共同執筆，共同撰寫，合著

example: Robert and his daughter have co-authored a diet book specifically written for young women.
羅伯特跟他女兒一起寫了一本有關健康飲食的書，目標讀者是年輕女性。

NONE: › the husband of your wife's sister
自己妻子姐姐（或妹妹）的丈夫
› to live or exist together at the same time or in the same place
共生；共處；共存

example: He does not believe that modern medicine can co-exist with faith-healing.
他不相信現代醫學能與信仰療法共存。

NONE: › (of an elected group) to make someone a member through the choice of the present members
（指由現有成員）增選…爲新成員，推舉…爲新成員
› to include someone in something, often against their will
強行拉進；拉攏，籠絡
› to use someone else's ideas
借鑒，借用（別人的觀點）

example: She was co-opted on to the committee last June.
去年六月她被增選爲委員會成員。
Whether they liked it or not, local people were co-opted into the victory parade.
不管願不願意，當地人都被強拉參加了勝利大遊行。
Rock and roll music was largely co-opted from the blues.
搖滾樂大量借鑒了布魯斯音樂。

NONE: › to be one of the people that takes responsibility for raising a child, especially when you are not the biological parent or you do not live with the child all of the time
（尤指作為非親生父母或不與小孩同住父母）共同承擔撫育子女的義務
› one of the people who takes responsibility for raising a child, especially one who is not the biological parent or does not live with the child all of the time
共同承擔撫育子女義務的家長（尤指作為非親生父母或不與小孩同住的父母），共親父母

example: I was in a long-term relationship with another woman and we decided to co-parent.
我與另一個女人交往多年，我們決定共同撫育子女。
We help separated couples to agree how best to co-parent the children.
我們幫助離婚分居夫妻在共同撫育子女方面達成一致意見。
Today, the majority of same-sex adoption cases involve a biological parent and a non-biological co-parent.
當今大部分同性領養的情況都是一方是子女的親生父母，另一方是共親父母。

NONE: › a pilot who helps the main pilot on an aircraft
（飛機的）副駕駛員
› a film, television programme, or theatre production organized by two or more people or organizations, rather than a single person or organization
（電影、電視節目、劇碼等的）聯合出品

example: The movie is a co-production, with input from Disney and the Children's Film Foundation.
這部電影由迪士尼和兒童電影基金會共同出資聯合製作。

NONE: › the person who a married person is said to have committed adultery (= sex outside marriage) with
（與他人配偶通姦的）共同被告

example: He was cited/named as co-respondent in the divorce.
他作爲該離婚案的共同被告被傳訊。
Compare
respondent

NONE: › the wife of your husband's brother
自己丈夫哥哥（或弟弟）的妻子
› a famous actor appearing with another famous actor in a film or a play, when both have parts of equal importance
合演者；聯合主演者
› to appear in a film or a play as a co-star
聯袂出演

example: The co-stars of "Casablanca" are Ingrid Bergman and Humphrey Bogart.
《北非諜影》由英格麗‧褒曼和漢弗萊‧博加特聯袂主演。
Katharine Hepburn co-starred with Spencer Tracy in many films.
凱瑟琳‧赫本和斯潘塞‧特雷西聯袂主演了多部影片。

NONE: › one of two or more women who are married to the same man in polygamy (= a system that allows this)
（一夫多妻制下）嫁給同一個男人的女人

example: He says his mother's disputes with her co-wife influenced him to choose monogamy.
他說他母親與他一夫多妻制下的太太發生了矛盾，這影響他最終選擇了一夫一妻制。

NONE: › a person who you work with, especially someone with a similar job or level of responsibility
同事，同僚；（尤指）共同工作者，幫手
› to write something with someone else, especially a popular song, or something for television or the cinema
合寫（尤指流行歌曲、電視或電影劇本）

example: Lennon and McCartney co-wrote most of the Beatles' songs.
披頭四樂隊的大多數歌曲是由藍儂和麥卡特尼合寫的。

NONE: › the last part of an internet address that belongs to a British company
（英國公司網際網路網址的最後部分）
